description: Half-site composition of an ODR-1 homodimer versus an ODR-1/DAF-11 heterodimer from the computed residue table
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
cols=["Asp\nmetal 1","Asp\nmetal 2","Glu\nguanine","Cys\nguanine","Asn\ntransition","Arg\ntransition"]
odr1=["Q844","E888","E884","C956","N963","R967"]; odr1ok=[0,0,1,1,1,1]
daf11=["D770","D814","E810","A882","I889","K893"]; daf11ok=[1,1,1,0,0,0]
# a class III site takes the 2 metal Asp from one subunit and Glu/Cys/Asn/Arg from the other
siteA=[("DAF-11",daf11[0],1),("DAF-11",daf11[1],1),("ODR-1",odr1[2],1),("ODR-1",odr1[3],1),("ODR-1",odr1[4],1),("ODR-1",odr1[5],1)]
siteB=[("ODR-1",odr1[0],0),("ODR-1",odr1[1],0),("DAF-11",daf11[2],1),("DAF-11",daf11[3],0),("DAF-11",daf11[4],0),("DAF-11",daf11[5],0)]
homoA=[("ODR-1",odr1[0],0),("ODR-1",odr1[1],0),("ODR-1",odr1[2],1),("ODR-1",odr1[3],1),("ODR-1",odr1[4],1),("ODR-1",odr1[5],1)]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(9.5,6.4),sharex=True)
for ax,(title,site) in zip(axes,[("ODR-1 homodimer, both sites identical: 4 of 6",homoA),
                                 ("ODR-1 / DAF-11 heterodimer, site 1: 6 of 6",siteA),
                                 ("ODR-1 / DAF-11 heterodimer, site 2: 1 of 6",siteB)]):
    for i,(sub,res,ok) in enumerate(site):
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((i,0),0.92,1,color="#2e7d32" if ok else "#c62828",alpha=0.78))
        ax.text(i+0.46,0.62,res,ha="center",va="center",color="w",fontsize=11,fontweight="bold")
        ax.text(i+0.46,0.28,sub,ha="center",va="center",color="w",fontsize=8.5)
    ax.set_xlim(0,6); ax.set_ylim(0,1); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_title(title,fontsize=11,loc="left")
    for s in ax.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
axes[-1].set_xticks(np.arange(6)+0.46); axes[-1].set_xticklabels(cols,fontsize=9)
fig.suptitle("Class III catalytic residues contributed to each active site\n(reference columns from rat GC-A P18910; green = canonical residue present)",fontsize=11.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
